messages.content: You are polishing copy for a real Openline brand library. Return JSON only: hero{eyebrow,title,description}, sections{ads:{title,description},motion:{title,description},presenters:{title,description},archive:{title,description}}, footer. Use exact hero title 'Everything Openline.' (user wants everything in one library); eyebrow 'The Openline brand library'; hero description warm and clear about logo files, motion, campaign ideas, product sources in one place, <=28words. No awkward title case or passive AI-sounding wording. Ads title 'Short ads, ready to explore.' with clear description that these are creative concepts for review, can play and download; avoid all hype. Motion original artwork plus new sound variations, GIFs silent. Presenters fictional AI Gary/Hellen with longer samples to compare delivery. Archive earlier directions and original sources retained, not deleted. Footer a simple Openline rights statement, no invented contact email, no invented licenses. No unsupported product, compliance or approval claims. No em dashes. Sentence case. Concise.
